[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew this red and white [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was piloted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Rise of the Cortosis Battle Droids|Cortosis Battle Droid threat]]. He flew it from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on a mission to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When Coruscant was then [[Coruscant Insurrection|attacked]], Anakin returned there in it. Soon afterward, he used the ship to travel to [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] to destroy the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|Cortosis Battle Droid]] factory.<ref name="Star Wars: The New Droid Army">''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]''</ref> Anakin would also end up using the stock Delta-7 during a [[Battle of Varonat|skirmish]] with pirates at [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]] and subsequently when [[Rescue at Riflor|rescuing]] his thought to be dead [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]].<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>
